scientific_question: Does eliminating discrete topology staleness by recomputing a stage-64 c_proj Givens topology from the exact current Muon direction on every update close the 124M full-attention-plus-c_proj loss gap without a learned dense basis, dense residual, or LoRA adapter?

causal_optimizer_protocol.matching: At every update, score hidden-channel edges from that update's exact coherent Muon polar direction and construct 64 edge-disjoint perfect matchings with the qualified compiled single-pass selector.
causal_optimizer_protocol.angles: At the same update, compute closed-form diagonal tangent-metric angles using only the current scheduled Muon update and freshly selected matchings.
causal_optimizer_protocol.state_transition: Apply the 64 Givens stages to the materialized c_proj weight, apply decoupled weight decay, and fold the result into the persistent base buffer.

decision_rule.primary_metric: terminal fixed-window validation cross entropy at update 238
decision_rule.success: Stable terminal validation CE at most 5.5918.
decision_rule.directional_only: Stable terminal validation CE below 5.662802696228027 but above 5.5918.
decision_rule.reject: Terminal validation CE at least 5.662802696228027, NaN/Inf/divergence, incomplete terminal evaluation, provenance mismatch, or incomplete exact-resume state.

authorization.scope: Exactly one immutable 124M/0.5TPP stateless-fresh stage-64 candidate.

scope_limit: This is a trainable-coordinate/manifold test. The dense folded c_proj base remains materialized in checkpoints and forward passes, so it does not claim checkpoint-size or inference-FLOP compression.
